title: Work & the Labour Market — Review
goal: Bring together workplace rules, proportional trends, correlative pairs, impersonals and contrast markers in labour-market Spanish.
grammar: infinitive vs que + subjunctive, cuanto más, no solo... sino (que), impersonals, contrast markers

items: I can contrast general workplace rules with obligations on another party using the infinitive and *que* + subjunctive.
I can describe proportional labour trends with *cuanto más* and *a medida que* and weigh dual factors with *no solo …, sino (que) también* and *tanto … como*.
I can report unnamed industry practices, generalise worker experiences with *uno / una*, and balance counter-arguments with formal contrast markers.
